claims: The 2026 NFL Draft will take place from April 23–25 in Pittsburgh.
The 2026 NFL Draft is held at the North Shore near Acrisure Stadium.
The 2026 NFL Draft will be broadcast on ESPN, ABC, and NFL Network.
The Las Vegas Raiders hold the first overall pick.
2026 NFL Draft Round 1 is on Thursday, April 23.
2026 NFL Draft Rounds 4-7 are on Saturday, April 25.
2026 NFL Draft location is Pittsburgh, PA (North Shore/Acrisure Stadium).
Top prospects for the 2026 NFL Draft are QB Fernando Mendoza, Edge Arvell Reese, OT Francis Mauigoa, Edge David Bailey.
2026 NFL Draft order top 5: Raiders, Jets, Cardinals, Titans, Giants.
The first 20 picks in the 2026 NFL Draft are assigned based on reverse order of finish for non-playoff teams.
Picks 21-32 in the 2026 NFL Draft are decided by playoff performance.
WR Brandon Aiyuk is appearing in trade rumors around the 2026 NFL Draft event.
The 2026 NFL Draft is accompanied by the free NFL Draft Experience featuring games, displays, and autograph sessions.
Coverage of the 2026 NFL Draft is available on NFL Network, ESPN, ABC, and the NFL App.
